register.reg_condition: when FEAT_GCIE is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: GIC Synchronization Barrier Interrupt Acknowledge ensures completion of the effects of the GICR CDIA and GICR CDNMIA instructions and prevents loads, stores, and GIC instructions from executing part of their functionality before the GSB ACK.
See 'Interrupt ordering model and synchronization requirements' in Arm® Generic Interrupt Controller Architecture Specification, GIC architecture version 5 (ARM IHI 111701) for more information.

attributes_text.para: GSB ACK is a 64-bit System instruction.

access_permission_text.para: The Rt field should be set to 0b11111. If the Rt field is not set to 0b11111, it is CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE whether:

content.para: The instruction behaves as if the Rt field is set to 0b11111.

access_permission_text.para: This system instruction is an alias of the SYS instruction.
